title: Aarsaa Hiree Jijjiire
intro: Bara dhala namaa isa jalqabaa keessa lubbuun tokko akeeka qulqulluudhaan kennaa dhiheessiti turte. Taʼus, inaaffaan gaaddidduu fudhatama argachuu keessa dhokatee ture. Seenaa fakkii kanaa kan Waaqayyoon sodaachuu fi dhumni isaa gaddisiisaa mul’ata waaqummaa keessatti kan hin duune ta’e argadhu.
clues: Dhaloota dhala namaa isa jalqabaa keessaa tokkon ture.
Gooftaa kootiif aarsaa dhiheessee, tolaan fudhatame.
Aarsaan obboleessi koo fudhatama dhabee, hinaaffaanis garaa isaa dukkaneesse.
Anis, ‘Ati na ajjeesuuf harka kee gara kootti yoo diriirsite, ani si ajjeesuuf harka koo hin diriirsu; dhugumatti Rabbiin Gooftaa adunyaa nan sodaadha’ jedheen.
Gocha ajjeechaa jalqabaa lafarratti raawwatameef miidhamaa taʼeera.
Dhiigni koo iyyee, wareegama qulqullummaa isa jalqabaa ta'e.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Aarsaan isaa fudhatama argachuun obboleessi isaa hinaaffaa fi ajjeechaa isaaf sababa ta’e
Ibidda boba'aa keessa darbatamee osoo hin miidhamiin ba'e
Qurxummii guddaa tokkoon liqimfamee dukkana keessa hafe
Saba isaa galaana addaan ba’e keessa geggeesse
trial.answer: Aarsaan isaa fudhatama argachuun obboleessi isaa hinaaffaa fi ajjeechaa isaaf sababa ta’e

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Seenaa keessatti ajjeechaa jalqabaa; obboleessi isaa ni balaaleffatame
Sababa irra daddarbaatiin gara sareetti jijjiirame
Bubbee hamaa fi qorraa ta'een barbadaa'e
Akka adabbiitti lolaa guddaa keessatti liqimfame
outcome.answer: Seenaa keessatti ajjeechaa jalqabaa; obboleessi isaa ni balaaleffatame

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
